description: A premium, modern, responsive photographer and videographer portfolio with a Next.js frontend, Express contact backend, MongoDB content schemas, media portfolio workflows, and production deployment guidance.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed React development with the existing Next.js starter.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript React development without static typing.

questions.rationale: The existing repository is already a Next.js TypeScript starter and the request explicitly asks for TypeScript.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and presentation features should be used?
questions.recommendedChoice: Next.js App Router with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, next/image, and next/font
questions.answer: Next.js App Router with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, next/image, and next/font

options.label: Next.js App Router with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, next/image, and next/font
options.description: Build on the existing Next 16 App Router starter with responsive styling, optimized media, cinematic motion, and accessible theme support.

questions.rationale: The repository already uses Next.js 16 with Tailwind CSS, and the request names the required frontend libraries and capabilities.

questions.question: Which language should the backend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed Node.js API development shared with the frontend toolchain.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript Node.js API development without static typing.

questions.rationale: The request asks for a Node.js Express backend and the rest of the project is TypeScript, so a typed API keeps the codebase consistent.

questions.question: Which backend framework and API features should be used?
questions.recommendedChoice: Node.js with Express, MongoDB/Mongoose, Nodemailer, validation, and admin CRUD routes
questions.answer: Node.js with Express, MongoDB/Mongoose, Nodemailer, validation, and admin CRUD routes

options.label: Node.js with Express, MongoDB/Mongoose, Nodemailer, validation, and admin CRUD routes
options.description: Provide contact/email handling, portfolio/testimonial/inquiry schemas, basic protected admin CRUD, and an Instagram integration boundary.

questions.rationale: The request explicitly requires Express, MongoDB schemas, Nodemailer contact handling, basic admin CRUD, seed data, and Instagram integration.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?

options.label: MongoDB
options.description: Portfolio items, testimonials, inquiries, admin-managed content, and seed data via MongoDB Atlas.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Durable storage and delivery for portfolio photography, video thumbnails, and uploaded media.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only static content and external services without application persistence.

questions.rationale: The app requires MongoDB schemas and serves portfolio media, so it needs MongoDB plus Blob Storage rather than a datastore-free setup.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to access application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require sign-in for application API features and admin access.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep the public portfolio and contact flow open; protect basic admin CRUD with a server-side admin mechanism defined in the plan.

questions.rationale: The request does not require visitor accounts; admin CRUD still needs a narrowly scoped server-side protection strategy.
